#
# 20.00 more than the bill owes, out of a split whose own figure is CAD
# scaffolding — which is the shape the overpayment carve cannot divide. Both

# in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
